name: Hospital Healthcare System
description: Hospital patient management system with admissions, doctors, and patient records. Practice date calculations and cost analysis.

tables.name: patients
tables.description: Patient master records with demographic and contact information

tables.name: doctors
tables.description: Medical staff directory with specializations and departments

tables.name: admissions
tables.description: Hospital admission records with diagnosis, costs, and insurance coverage

relationships.description: Each admission belongs to one patient
Each admission is handled by one primary doctor

sample_queries.title: Average Length of Stay by Department
sample_queries.description: Calculate average hospital stay duration grouped by medical department
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  d.department,
  COUNT(a.admission_id) as total_admissions,
  AVG(a.length_of_stay_days) as avg_stay_days,
  AVG(a.total_cost_idr) as avg_cost
FROM doctors d
JOIN admissions a ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
GROUP BY d.department
ORDER BY total_admissions DESC;

sample_queries.title: Top 10 Most Common Diagnoses
sample_queries.description: Most frequently occurring diagnoses in admission records
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  diagnosis,
  COUNT(*) as case_count,
  AVG(length_of_stay_days) as avg_stay,
  AVG(total_cost_idr) as avg_total_cost,
  AVG(insurance_covered_idr) as avg_insurance_covered
FROM admissions
GROUP BY diagnosis
ORDER BY case_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

sample_queries.title: Insurance Coverage Analysis
sample_queries.description: Compare out-of-pocket costs across different payment types
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  payment_type,
  COUNT(*) as admission_count,
  AVG(total_cost_idr) as avg_total_cost,
  AVG(insurance_covered_idr) as avg_insurance_covered,
  AVG(total_cost_idr - insurance_covered_idr) as avg_out_of_pocket,
  (AVG(insurance_covered_idr) / AVG(total_cost_idr) * 100) as avg_coverage_pct
FROM admissions
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY avg_coverage_pct DESC;

sample_queries.title: Doctor Workload by Specialization
sample_queries.description: Number of patients treated per doctor grouped by specialization
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  d.specialization,
  d.doctor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) as unique_patients,
  COUNT(a.admission_id) as total_admissions,
  SUM(a.length_of_stay_days) as total_patient_days
FROM doctors d
LEFT JOIN admissions a ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.specialization, d.doctor_name
ORDER BY total_admissions DESC;
